definitions.false_acceptance: false acceptance: the defended judge accepts the selected plan and the 32-seed majority oracle rejects it, over instances
definitions.false_rejection: false rejection: among selected plans the oracle accepts, the share the defended judge rejects
definitions.real_success: real success: the oracle accepts the selected plan, over instances
definitions.emulator_accepts: the defended judge accepts the selected plan, over instances
definitions.baseline: the setting's own undefended model, from its judge field: member 0 or the ensemble
definitions.difference: defended rate minus the baseline's rate on the same instances (point value)
definitions.intervals: as stored in frontier.json: cluster bootstrap over city families, 2,000 resamples, seed 0, 95 per cent; BCa with the percentile interval where BCa is undefined
definitions.penalty_increments: a penalty setting's rate minus the lambda = 0 row's (point value)
